title: Missing-data sensitivity analysis
purpose: Shows how complete-case analysis, simple imputation, and best/worst-case assumptions can change estimated outcomes and costs.
input: `Data` sheet with outcome, age, risk score, and cost; some cells may be blank.
outputs: Missingness profile, scenario table, sensitivity chart, and summary of the plausible estimate range.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
